jobs.title: Senior Director, Data & Analytics
jobs.description:
Our Company Background & Culture

UPP is the first pension plan of its kind in Ontario’s university sector, proudly serving over 46,000 members across six universities and nineteen sector organizations. Our purpose is to bring greater retirement peace of mind to the university sector by investing with integrity and serving members with care. As a sector-wide plan designed for growth, our doors are open to all Ontario universities.

UPP is recognized as one of Greater Toronto’s Top Employers for 2026. Together, we’re a team of progressive thinkers and agile doers operating within a fast-paced culture of collaboration and respect. We believe in bringing smart and capable people together to create, solve, and grow with a clear shared vision and values of integrity, inclusivity, ingenuity, and impact.

Our culture is intentionally welcoming and purposefully rooted in equity, diversity, inclusion, and reconciliation (EDI&R). We believe diverse teams, perspectives, and lived experiences contribute to better decisions and a better workplace.

As a pension plan, UPP approaches investing through a long-term lens to generate and safeguard value. Our commitment to investing responsibly accounts for material risks that impact our investment portfolio to generate sufficient risk-adjusted returns to meet the pension needs of our members.

Join us in building a bright future for our members, our organization, and each other.

THE ROLE

We are seeking a forward-looking Senior Director, Data & Analytics to lead and evolve UPP’s enterprise data capabilities. Reporting to the Managing Director, Data and Technology, this role will work with business and technology leaders to improve how data is governed, integrated, managed and used across UPP. Its scope includes data in UPP’s enterprise data hub and across the broader cloud solutions ecosystem, including Google Cloud Platform (GCP). The Senior Director will help ensure data is trusted, accessible and fit for business reporting, analytics, automation and emerging AI workloads.

This is an opportunity for an experienced data leader to shape an important enterprise capability and help UPP make better use of its data as the organization grows.

This role is based in downtown Toronto under a hybrid work policy, allowing employees the flexibility to work remotely and in-office (two days per week in-office).

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Specific Accountabilities

The Senior Director, Data & Analytics will lead and evolve UPP’s data capabilities, including the following:

Develop and evolve UPP’s enterprise data strategy and practices so data is well governed, reliable, discoverable and useful across the organization.
Lead and develop a high-performing team responsible for data quality, data engineering, data integration, data operations and analytics enablement.
Establish data standards and practices in partnership with business data owners, Architecture, Cybersecurity and other technology teams.
Guide the use of cloud-based data capabilities, including GCP, to support reliable data integration, reporting and analytics. Improve data quality, access, lineage and governance so data is ready for responsible automation and AI workloads, in partnership with the teams accountable for AI platforms, architecture, privacy and cybersecurity.
Partner with business and technology leaders to prioritize data needs and enable trusted, data-informed decisions. Establish the access patterns, tools, standards, training and controls that allow business users, including citizen data users, to work with data safely and at scale.
Improve the reliability, quality, reuse and maintainability of data integration and transformation flows that support key processes, including pension data conversion, regular employer reporting, and Finance reporting and analysis.
Leverage leading frameworks (such as DCAM) to continually mature and evolve the data strategy and frequently self-asses the capabilities for progress
Define and communicate data priorities, target capabilities and roadmaps, aligning plans with enterprise needs and available capacity.
Research and establish peer connections to understand industry trends and their applicability to support data plans and strategies for the enterprise
Explain the value of trusted data and sound data management practices to technical and non-technical audiences.
Oversee UPP’s data catalog and related metadata practices, working with Architecture and data owners to improve data discoverability and stewardship.
Contribute to UPP’s reputation as a respectful employer, partner, and participant in the financial sector

Qualifications & Experience

10+ years of demonstrated experience developing and leading enterprise data capabilities, including data governance, data engineering, integration, data operations and analytics.
CDMP (Certified Data Management Professional) or an equivalent qualification is an asset.
Significant progressive experience in data management, including data governance, architecture, integration, data quality, metadata and analytics.
Experience leading data teams or capabilities in a cloud-based environment, with sufficient technical understanding of data platforms, databases, integration and transformation tools, analytics and visualization to set direction and make informed decisions. Experience with GCP or comparable cloud data platforms is an asset.
Understanding of relational and non-relational data and the considerations involved in integrating and governing different data types.
Experience working across complex business domains; experience in pensions, investments or financial services is an asset.
Experience designing and evolving cloud-based data capabilities in partnership with internal teams and external service providers.
Working knowledge of analytics methods and the interpretation of quantitative information.

ATTRIBUTES

Excellent written and verbal communications
Ability to design and improve repeatable data practices
Ability to drive outcomes through collaboration across teams and contributors
Ability to engage and align business users, data owners and technology partners.
Ability to effectively identify emerging technologies, trends, standards, and products that have a strong potential to better enable UPP business units
Ability to enable consistent, governed data use at scale.

LIFE AT UPP

Do work that matters.
We are duty-bound to serve our members’ interests, and it’s a responsibility we don’t take lightly. That’s why we’ve ingrained sustainability in our work from day one—to ensure our members have a resilient future to retire into, both today and for generations to come.

Stronger together.
Collaboration is how UPP was born, and it’s how we work with each other and our partners day in, day out. No one at UPP is just a number (even if they are excellent at math) and every win is a shared win.

Grow every day.
You’ll have the opportunity to work on unique, once-in-a-career projects that maximize your skill set and probably teach you some new ones—at any stage in your career.

Benefits

Prioritize wellness.
At UPP, wellness takes many forms. Ultimately, it’s about ensuring our people are cared for in the ways that matter to them. Check out some highlights of our inclusive employee-focused benefits program including:

Defined benefit pension plan
Flexible hybrid work model
Paid time off – vacations, personal days and wellness days
Work remotely up to eight weeks/year
Comprehensive group benefits including medical, dental, vision, etc.
Extended paramedical and mental health service coverage
Health care and lifestyle spending accounts
Fertility treatments, paid parental leave, and gender affirmation coverage
Education Assistance program

This posting will remain open for a minimum of seven (7) days and will remain open until a sufficient number of qualified applications are received or finalist candidates have been identified.

Artificial intelligence (AI) tools may be used to support certain stages of the recruitment process, including sourcing, screening, and assessment. All hiring decisions involve human review and intervention by UPP employees.

UPP enthusiastically welcomes applications from all qualified applicants and especially invites people with lived experience as an Indigenous person, a person with a disability or as a member of another Human Rights Code protected group that faces barriers to employment to apply. Our goal is to create a barrier-free experience for every candidate throughout the recruitment process.

UPP respects your privacy. For information on how UPP handles the personal information you provide during the application process, please see our Job Applicant Privacy Statement.

jobs.title: Vice President of Financial Planning Analysis
jobs.description:
VP of Finance

Hybrid (2 Days in Vaughan)

Oakbridge Search Partners has been retained by a leading, multi-entity Canadian services organization to hire a VP of FP&A. This is a ground-floor opportunity to build the finance function for a new initiative with the backing of an established parent organization.

The Opportunity

As VP of Finance, you'll own financial management, reporting, and controls for a complex, multi-workstream initiative. You'll lead budgeting, forecasting, treasury, and audit, design processes and controls from scratch, and report into the broader organization. This role is for a builder who takes ownership, makes decisions independently, and wants to shape something from day one.

What You'll Do

Own financial tracking and reporting (monthly, quarterly, and ad hoc) for leadership and the ownership group
Build and maintain budgets and forecasts across all workstreams; monitor variances and recommend corrective action
Lead treasury management and the annual audit process
Design and implement financial processes and internal controls
Review vendor contracts, invoices, and POs, and support procurement decisions with financial analysis
Partner with Project Managers and Leadership to provide financial input into planning and prioritization
Identify and mitigate financial risk while ensuring compliance with policies and standards

What You Bring

CPA designation (CA, CMA, or CGA legacy designations accepted)
8 to 12 years of progressive finance experience, including 3 to 5 years in a senior finance leadership role
Direct experience managing an annual audit and preparing financials under ASPE
Strong technical accounting skills and Canadian tax knowledge (corporate income tax, GST/HST, payroll compliance)
Proficiency with accounting software (QuickBooks, Sage, NetSuite, or similar) and advanced Excel modelling
Comfort operating at both a strategic and hands-on level, from presenting to ownership to booking a month-end entry
Experience managing financials for projects, operations, or business units in a fast-paced, multi-stakeholder environment
Nice to have: experience in project-based environments (construction, technology, implementation, or consulting), procurement and vendor management, or system implementation projects

Location & Travel

Hybrid, with two days per week in office at one of the organization's Ontario locations, plus travel to other Ontario sites approximately twice per month.

What's Offered

Comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits, plus mental health and wellness resources
Three weeks of vacation to start, paid sick and personal days
Full company shutdown between Christmas and New Year's
A collaborative, supportive culture with a genuine commitment to growth and development

Ne perdez pas le rythme - Postulez chez Les Industries JAM !

JAM, faire que le monde sonne mieux, une marqueà la fois! Est-ce que ces mots résonnent comme de la musique à vos oreilles?

Depuis 1972, les JAM est devenu un des plus importants distributeurs de matériel électronique, d’appareillage de sonorisation professionnelle et d’instruments de musique. Venez nous joindre pour demeurer fidèle à notre mission première d’offrir UNIQUEMENT le meilleur service à la clientèle possible!

Relève de :
Vice-président principal, Transformation numérique

Résumé du poste

Relevant du vice-président principal, Transformation numérique, le ou la Directeur(trice) de projet, Transformation financière
joue un rôle stratégique à un moment charnière de la croissance de Nexora Amérique du Nord, alors que l’organisation passe de systèmes hérités fragmentés à une infrastructure de calibre entreprise. Ce poste exige une expertise approfondie en consolidation d’opérations mondiales, en mise à l’échelle de systèmes pour soutenir une forte croissance et en modernisation des opérations, processus, systèmes et capacités stratégiques de la fonction Finance.

Aperçu du rôle

Définir et diriger la stratégie globale de transformation financière afin de faire évoluer des systèmes régionaux fragmentés vers un modèle financier mondial standardisé et évolutif.

Relevant directement du vice-président principal, Transformation numérique, avec un lien fonctionnel de projet auprès du chef de la direction financière (CFO).

Assurer un leadership transversal auprès de multiples entités, fonctions et unités d’affaires afin de favoriser la réussite des initiatives de transformation.

Principales responsabilités

Élaborer et mettre en œuvre la feuille de route complète de transformation financière à l’échelle mondiale.

Assurer la gouvernance des projets, incluant les budgets, les échéanciers, les ressources, les risques et les livrables.

Diriger le déploiement de plateformes ERP, de solutions d’automatisation et de capacités avancées en analytique.

Piloter les initiatives de standardisation des processus et d’amélioration continue à travers l’organisation.

Harmoniser les processus Record-to-Report (R2R)
, Order-to-Cash (O2C)
et Procure-to-Pay (P2P)
au sein de multiples unités d’affaires.

Moderniser les capacités de données et d’analytique en mettant en place des cadres de gouvernance des données d’entreprise et en automatisant les rapports financiers ainsi que les tableaux de bord FP&A.

Développer des modèles d’intégration financière évolutifs et reproductibles afin de soutenir les futures fusions, acquisitions et intégrations d’entreprises.

Diriger les activités de gestion du changement et agir comme principal point de liaison entre les équipes Finance, Technologies de l’information et les dirigeants régionaux.

Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes TI, Opérations, Finance et les unités d’affaires afin d’assurer l’alignement et la réussite des initiatives de transformation.

Qualifications Minimales

Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en finance, comptabilité, administration des affaires ou dans un domaine connexe.

12 à 15 ans ou plus d’expérience progressive en leadership financier, transformation organisationnelle, gestion de programmes ou direction de projets d’envergure. Une expérience en consultation constitue un atout.

Solide expertise des plateformes ERP, notamment SAP et Oracle, ainsi que des outils de gestion des données, de production de rapports et d’analytique.

Les certifications professionnelles telles que CPA, ACCA, PMP ou Six Sigma sont fortement privilégiées.

Exigences linguistiques

Bilinguisme en français et anglais.

Pourquoi vous joindre à nous

Prêt(e) à faire partie de notre équipe? Voici pourquoi…

Régime complet d’avantages sociaux : assurance santé, dentaire, vision, vie, maladie grave, invalidité de courte et longue durée
Programme de mieux-être et programme d’aide aux employés
Programme de cotisation de contrepartie REER / 401(k)
L’équilibre travail-vie personnelle est important : horaire flexible, heures d’été, vacances payées et congés personnels
Un environnement de travail décontracté, agréable et collaboratif
Un calendrier social dynamique — il y en a pour tous les goûts
Rabais généreux sur nos produits pour les employés
Opportunités continues d’apprentissage et de développement
La possibilité de travailler aux côtés d’une équipe hautement talentueuse et performante

Engagements en milieu de travail

Nous nous engageons à offrir un environnement de travail sain et sécuritaire. Tous les employés doivent respecter les protocoles de sécurité au travail, y compris les réglementations locales et les normes internes, afin d’assurer le bien-être de tous.

Nous avons à cœur de favoriser un milieu de travail où chaque personne se sent respectée, soutenue et en mesure de contribuer pleinement. Nous reconnaissons que la diversité des perspectives et des expériences renforce nos équipes et permet de meilleurs résultats pour nos employés et nos clients.

Nexora et sa famille de marques, incluant JAM et Almo, souscrivent au principe de l’égalité des chances en emploi. Toutes les décisions relatives à l’emploi sont prises sans égard à la race, la couleur, la religion, le sexe, l’identité ou l’expression de genre, l’orientation sexuelle, l’origine nationale, l’âge, le handicap, le statut d’ancien combattant ou tout autre statut protégé en vertu des lois applicables.

Don't skip a beat, apply to JAM Industries!

JAM, making the world sound better, one brand at a time! Do these words sound like music to your ears?

Since 1972, JAM has grown to be one of the largest distributors of consumer electronic goods, pro-audio equipment, and musical instruments. Come join us to stay true to our mission of delivering ONLY the best customer service!

Reporting To:
SVP, Digital Transformation

Position Summary

Reporting to the SVP, Digital Transformation, the Finance Transformation Project Director operates at a critical inflection point as Nexora North America transitions from fragmented legacy systems to an enterprise-grade infrastructure. This role requires deep expertise in consolidating global operations and scaling systems to support high growth while leading large-scale modernization initiatives across finance operations, systems, processes, and strategic capabilities.

Role Overview

Define and lead the global finance transformation strategy, supporting the transition from fragmented regional systems to a standardized and scalable finance operating model.

Report directly to the SVP, Digital Transformation, with a dotted-line project reporting relationship to the Chief Financial Officer (CFO).

Provide leadership across multiple entities, functions, and business units to ensure successful transformation outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and execute the end-to-end global finance transformation roadmap.

Oversee project governance, including budgets, timelines, resources, risks, and key deliverables.

Lead the deployment of ERP platforms, automation solutions, and advanced analytics capabilities.

Drive process standardization and continuous improvement initiatives across the organization.

Unify Record-to-Report (R2R), Order-to-Cash (O2C), and Procure-to-Pay (P2P) processes across multiple business units.

Modernize data and analytics capabilities by establishing enterprise data governance frameworks and automating financial reporting and FP&A dashboards.

Develop scalable financial integration playbooks to support future mergers, acquisitions, and business integrations.

Lead change management initiatives and serve as the key liaison between Corporate Finance, Information Technology, and regional business leaders.

Partner closely with IT, Operations, Finance, and business unit leaders to ensure alignment and successful execution of transformation initiatives.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related discipline.

12–15+ years of progressive experience in finance leadership, transformation, program management, or large-scale project leadership. Consulting experience is considered an asset.

Strong expertise with ERP platforms such as SAP and Oracle, as well as data management, reporting, and analytics tools.

Professional certifications such as CPA, ACCA, PMP, or Six Sigma are highly preferred.

Language Requirements

Bilingual in English & French.

Why Join Us

Ready to join our team? Here’s why …

Comprehensive group benefits: Health, Dental, Vision, Life, Critical Illness, Short- and Long-Term Disability
Wellness Incentive Program and Employee Assistance Program
RRSP / 401(k) matching program
Work-life balance matters: Flextime, summer hours, paid vacation, and personal time off
A casual, fun, and collaborative work environment
Lively social calendar—there’s always something for everyone
Generous employee discounts on our products
Ongoing learning and development opportunities
The chance to work alongside a highly talented, high-performing team

Workplace Commitments

We are committed to providing a safe and healthy work environment. All employees are expected to follow workplace safety protocols, including compliance with local regulations and internal standards, to ensure the well-being of everyone.

We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where individuals feel respected, supported, and able to contribute fully. We recognize that different perspectives and experiences strengthen our teams and drive better outcomes for our employees and customers.

Nexora and its family of brands, including JAM and Almo, are equal opportunity employers. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable law.
